Initial release of Image to Video No Filter — fast, unfiltered image-to-video conversion.

- Automatic connection and authentication: 100 free credits per new user.
- Supports quick social content generation and batch or iterative workflows.
- Error handling and helpful guidance for uploads, export, and session issues.
